name: @kirkelliott/ket
description: General-purpose quantum circuit simulator. Immutable TypeScript API, four backends, 14 import/export formats, zero dependencies.
author: kirkelliott

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --external:node:worker_threads --outfile=dist/ket.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --external:node:worker_threads --outfile=dist/ket.min.js && esbuild src/mps.worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/mps.worker.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
